name: Masala Popcorn
steps: Heat oil in a large lidded pot over medium heat. Add three kernels; when all pop, add the remaining kernels in one layer and cover.
Shake the covered pot every few seconds until popping slows to one pop every 2–3 seconds, about 4 minutes. Immediately pour into a wide bowl.
In a small pan melt butter, fry curry leaves until crisp, then switch off the heat. Stir in chilli and turmeric for 10 seconds.
Drizzle the spiced butter over the popcorn while tossing continuously. Sprinkle salt and chaat masala in two additions for even coverage.
Remove unpopped kernels, taste a warm handful and serve at once while the popcorn is crisp.
tips: Add dry spices only after turning off the heat; powdered chilli scorches quickly.
notes: Quantities serve four adults. Check the doneness cues in each step and adjust seasoning to taste. Jain suitability depends on your household ingredient rules.
